who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane blaze-remote, fix-hello-1113, round 2
where: crates/blaze-remote/src/bundle.rs, segment.rs, shard.rs, trust.rs, exec.rs (every wire type with a limit)
what: A bundle's segment length was a bare u64 bounded only by its decoder, so an encoder could write a bundle its own decoder refused (Hegel: a length of 4 GiB + 1); the same shape held for key lists, manifests, roots, outcomes and batches.
cost: one failing property test found by the main agent; every limited field was a latent producer of objects no reader takes
cause: a limit written as a check in the decoder, not as the type of the field, so the encoder and every builder were free of it
class: a wire limit enforced on one side of a round trip only
prevention: every limited field has a type that cannot hold a value past the limit, built through one checked constructor used by the decoder too: SegmentLen, SegmentRef::new, Run::new, Entry::new, Batch::new, and Bounded<T, MOST> for every list; generators draw through the same constructors
fix: segment.rs SegmentLen and SegmentRef (moved from bundle.rs), wire.rs Bounded, shard.rs Run::new and Entry::new, exec.rs Batch::new; tests.rs nothing_past_a_limit_can_be_built (uncompiled at the time of writing)
state: fixed, unverified until the main agent runs the tests
